admission_modes.full: admit all 17 streamfold_sumcheck_toy_v2_family payloads by exact path, byte length, SHA-256, and JSON parseability
admission_modes.minimum: admit only the 4-file first recovery set by exact path, byte length, SHA-256, and JSON parseability

artifact_role: executable candidate-root admission contract for the 17 canonical streamfold_sumcheck_toy_v2_family payloads
candidate_root_rules: candidate root must be a real directory, not a symlink
expected payload paths must remain clean POSIX-relative paths below the candidate root
selected expected payload paths must exist as regular files below the candidate root
each candidate payload must match INDEX/files.csv and payload_manifest.rev0855.json by SHA-256 and byte length
JSON and DSSE-named payloads must parse as JSON objects before admission
DSSE/SCITT shape is reported as structural lint, but exact SHA-256 remains the admission authority
candidate payload admission does not modify the overlay and does not grant publication rights
